<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Open a return receipt against an RMA"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/returns/{rmaId}/receipts"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Records the physical arrival of returned goods. Each line either
matches an RMA (`kind: MATCHED`, carrying its own `rmaId`, which may
differ from the path's RMA when several RMAs ship in one parcel) or is
explicitly `kind: UNEXPECTED`; any other shape is 400 `invalid-line`
(no silent third state). UNEXPECTED lines raise
`UnexpectedReturnReceived` for exception-management. Publishes
`ReturnReceiptOpened` through the outbox. The service does NOT look
the RMA up: an `rmaId` (path or line) that names no RMA is accepted,
and the RMA keeps its status (nothing moves it to RECEIVED today), so
this operation has no 404 and no `rma-not-receivable` 409; its 409 is
`idempotency-key-reused`. Requires an `Idempotency-Key`.

  as={"h2"}
